bio: Hello! My name is Florencia Luz Duarte. I am a Front-end Developer and Product Designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

texts.text1: After 10+ years working as a Designer, I decided to give programming a chance and it ended up stealing my heart (professionally speaking).
texts.text2: What started with a few lines of code, ended up scaling to a professional transformation, which has led me to learn web programming on my own for the last 2+ years.
texts.text3: During this process, I have managed to:
texts.text4: My mission is to act as a bridge between the worlds of Programming and Design, making the most of both facets of my professional journey for the development of websites and apps.

list.text1: Develop multiple websites/apps for different clients.
list.text2: Build a tech community for programmers called Unicornio Dev.
list.text3: Create technical content and open source projects on multiple platforms.
list.text4: Actively collaborate with other technology communities in LATAM.
list.text5: Be a recurring speaker at web development events.
list.text6: Give +30 free mentoring sessions to other developers.

unicornio.description: Unicornio dev is a tech community that emerged as a space to learn in public and exchange knowledge with other Devs. I continue to develop this personal project while deepening my professional path as a Web Developer. Nowadays, Unicornio dev has +10k followers in total across different social platforms.
